newsitem.title: KENYA: Coffee prices seen firm at Kenyan auction.
newsitem.headline: Coffee prices seen firm at Kenyan auction.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices firmed further overall at the weekly Kenya auction on Monday reflecting bullish tones in overseas markets, auction officials said.
Grade Cs averaged $192 per 50-kg bag from $178, while grade ABs averaged $199 per bag from $184.5. Grade AAs averaged $201 from $185.5.
"Further advances in the overseas market gave local prices an increase of $13," a coffee board of Kenya report said.
The coffee board said it sold all 21,765 60-kg bags it offered for sale compared to 22,020 bags sold last week. --Wambui Chege, Nairobi Newsroom ++254-2 330-261
